patterns.skill_gap: None material; the versioned-stride + counted-skip design needed no new APIs beyond the already-verified GetSpecializationInfoByID global.
patterns.what_hard: A missing-locals edit slip (classID/specID never stored) failed 8 checks at once; direct serializer probing isolated it in one step. My isolationSweep reuse in the skip pins advanced the fake clock past the 120 s re-probe window; plain tick() fixed it.
patterns.what_worked: Baseline suite + old-byte measurement before any edit; pre-existing tree modifications verified untouched via the opening git status; per-block check counts re-derived rather than trusted from the changelog.
